exposure: N-nitro-L-arginine methyl ester injection (to induce IUGR)
outcome: Levels of pulmonary surfactant-associated protein A (SP-A)
Ultrastructural changes in type II alveolar epithelial cells (AEC II)
cohort: Twenty pregnant rabbits were divided into four groups (normal, IUGR, UTI, and LY) to investigate the effect of ulinastatin on lung development in IUGR fetal rabbits.
finding: Intraperitoneal ulinastatin injection promotes lung development and increases pulmonary surfactant production in IUGR fetal rabbits, potentially by activating the PI3K/Akt/eNOS/NO signaling pathway.
birth_weight: Neonatal weights were measured; the IUGR group showed significantly decreased weight compared to the control group, but specific inclusion criteria for birth weight were not mentioned.
